title: Aseryx research: held-out tests of the Aseryx readiness score
description:
The test record behind the Aseryx readiness score, a 0 to 100 rating of how clean and well-formed a table is.

Held-out set 9: 160 public files registered before download, labelled from their publishers' own documentation, and scored once by every version of the score from v6 to v11. No version passed.

The record gives every file's source, licence, SHA-256 and score per version, 95% bootstrap intervals on every comparison, every exclusion and deviation, and a Groth16 zero-knowledge proof of every v11 score, checkable against a published verification key and a verifier contract on Avalanche Fuji. The scoring rules and engines are not published.
